title: Worker API messages (HTTPS, /api/worker/*, bearer worker token)
description: Workers dial out to the server and poll for jobs. POST /api/worker/claim answers 204 (nothing to do) or a job. While working, the worker POSTs reports to /api/worker/jobs/{id}/report (log chunks, at least every 60 s as a heartbeat) and gets an ack telling it whether to stop. A build ends with the firmware package (multipart field 'file', a zip per firmware-manifest) POSTed to /api/worker/jobs/{id}/package, or with a report carrying 'failed'.

oneOf.description: Server to worker: a claimed build job. Build ref (a branch, tag or commit of the repository) with profile, clean, and upload the package.
Worker to server: progress. 'log' is appended to the job's log. 'failed' ends the job as failed with that reason.
Server to worker: answer to a report. cancel true means an admin cancelled the job (or it's no longer this worker's): stop and don't upload.

ref.description: Git branch, tag or commit. Never starts with '-', so it can't be read as a git option.
